ingredients.group: Or, apple baby (instead of plain batter)

steps.title: Melt the butter
steps.body: In a 9×13 pan, or in muffin tins, melt the following in a hot oven: **6 Tbsp butter**.

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.body: In a blender, or with a mixer, combine: **1 cup milk**, **6 eggs**, **½ tsp salt** and **1 cup flour**.

steps.title: Apple baby option
steps.body: For the apple baby, before adding batter to buttered pans, place brown sugar and thin-sliced apples and cinnamon in bottom of pan, then add batter.

steps.title: Pour and bake
steps.body: Pour batter into hot buttered pan and bake for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Invert the apple baby
steps.body: For the apple baby, invert baking pan when done, and serve with apples on top.
